changes: TBESH: retain columns eStrong through Gloss; omit Meaning entirely. TAHOT: retain only primary word-row reference, dStrongs, and grammar; omit text, translations, interlinear duplicates and variant-detail columns. TAHOT primary word rows; Qere followed; L/Q/R/V and other main readings retained; X (reconstructed LXX additions) excluded; lexical roots only; bound affixes/punctuation (H9000+) excluded; identical root continuations after + counted once; dStrong senses aggregated to eStrong IDs, preserving eStrong suffixes; alternate-detail and interlinear rows not counted. Unicode whitespace normalized; gloss HTML entities decoded; senses merged by eStrong, alternate forms retained. Study gloss uses the first source entry's head before a colon; all original short glosses remain in glosses. Explicit TBESH A: entries are separated into aramaic.json with unchanged IDs. Shared/proper names without explicit Aramaic identification remain in the Hebrew collection. No long definitions imported.
